lore: Every save on DiskSaver Island is chalked onto the slates of five quays, each copy marked with its tally. Storms close quays without warning. The harbourmaster's rule: a new save counts once enough quays have chalked it, and anyone asking for a save asks enough quays and trusts the highest tally. Ask too few and you may hear an old tally; demand every quay and the first storm stops the harbour.

lines.start: Five quays, twelve hundred saves, and a storm season. Chalk enough slates and ask enough quays.
lines.storm: Surf's over the north quays. Work with the slates you can reach.
lines.read: Three slates say three different tallies? Trust the highest. That's the latest save.
lines.win: Not one old tally handed out all season, and the harbour hardly ever stopped.
lines.fail: Either somebody got handed an old save or the harbour stood still in every storm. Fix your counts.
